title: WPMS/2202/2019 of BADRI DUTT Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
Recall Application (MCC No. 865 of 2019)
In
WPMS No. 2202 of 2019
Hon'ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. G.C. Kandpal, Advocate for the
petitioner/applicant.
Mr. Darshan Singh Bisht, Brief Holder
for the State of Uttarakhand.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
This application seeking recall of the
order dated 31.07.2019 passed by this Court
has been filed by the petitioner with the
contention that under the garb of the orders
passed by Prescribed Authority, which was
affirmed by District Judge, the respondents
are going to evict the petitioner from one and
a half nali land, which was lawfully allotted
to him in the year 1975 under the provisions
of Government Grants Act.
Since the proceedings under the Public
Premises (Eviction of Unauthorised
Occupants) Act, 1971 were initiated against
the petitioner in respect of certain plots
specified in the notice issued under Section
4 of the said Act, therefore respondents
cannot evict the petitioner from the adjoining
land, which was not covered by the said
notice.
In such view of the matter, petitioner's
possession over the adjoining land, which
was not covered by the notice under the
aforesaid Act and the orders passed by
Prescribed Authority and District Judge,
shall remain protected and petitioner shall
not be dispossessed from the said land.
Accordingly, the recall application
stands disposed of.
